banker.prompt: Create a NEW premium fantasy character illustration: one majestic GOLD-AND-CRIMSON imperial CHINESE DRAGON for a baccarat banker streak celebration. Full dragon only, isolated on genuine transparent background. Tall elegant S-shaped serpentine body coiled into one substantial lower loop, with a tapered curling tail, four short naturally attached clawed limbs, and a powerful head high in the upper half in three-quarter view facing right. Dragon should fill most of a square canvas with comfortable clear margins and no clipped horns, tail or flame. Visual direction: polished, richly sculpted high-end 3D fantasy/game cinematic artwork, like a gold dragon sculpture brought to life, detailed individually shaped GOLD scales, red/copper shadows between scales, bright champagne-gold horns and belly plates, vivid deep CRIMSON mane and swept-back flame-shaped dorsal fins. Fierce noble adult face, readable eyes and snout, long flowing whiskers, branching elegant golden antler-like horns, open mouth exhaling a compact graceful curl of golden-orange fire toward the right, as part of the silhouette. The dominant body color is lustrous GOLD with clear red accents, not a solid red creature. Balanced realistic anatomy, intricate but clean scale detail, substantial dimensional light and shadow, studio key light from upper left, warm rim light, strong luminous gold highlights without overexposure. This is the RED member of a coordinated red/blue Eastern dragon pair: keep a coherent refined character-design language and proportional scale that can be matched by a blue sibling later. No western wings, no cartoon or chibi proportions, no jewelry outfit, no pedestal, no environment, no road-board UI, no disc, no medallion frame, no magic circle, no floating particle field, no text, no logo, no numbers, no letters. Transparent outside the dragon and its compact flame. Finished character key art suitable as the clean source image for future animation.

player.prompt: Create a NEW premium fantasy character illustration: one majestic SAPPHIRE-BLUE imperial CHINESE DRAGON for a baccarat player streak celebration. A coordinated sibling to a gold-and-crimson Chinese dragon: the SAME polished, richly sculpted high-end 3D fantasy/game cinematic style, similar anatomical proportions, scale detail, upper-left studio key light, dimensional material quality and visual weight. This must be a distinct sibling design, NOT the same red dragon merely recolored. Full wingless Eastern dragon only on genuine transparent background, with an elegant serpentine body, one substantial flowing lower coil and a curling tapered tail, four short naturally attached clawed limbs, noble mature face high in the upper half in three-quarter view. Distinct blue design features: a slightly longer and more streamlined snout, graceful swept-back CURVED golden horns with fewer branches, longer silvery-blue whiskers, a flowing icy-cyan and dark-blue mane with smooth wave-like dorsal fins instead of the red dragon's sharp flame-shaped crest, and a different graceful raised-neck/lower-body coil pose with a more inward-curving tail. Keep the head powerful and recognisably from the same dragon family, not a completely different species. Main scales are luminous metallic SAPPHIRE and deep cobalt blue with turquoise/cyan edge highlights; keep polished champagne-gold belly plates, horns and restrained gold accents so the paired dragons feel coordinated. Cool blue/cyan rim light. Open mouth may release a small soft curl of pale icy-blue breath, controlled and compact, matching the red sibling's small fire breath in visual weight. Fierce but regal expression, crisp readable eyes and snout, long whiskers, detailed individually shaped scales with clean sculpted bevels, natural joints and anatomy. Tall elegant composition inside a square canvas; leave generous transparent margin around EVERY extremity so no horn, claw, tail or breath is clipped. No western wings, no cartoon or chibi proportions, no oversized armor suit, no jewelry outfit, no pedestal, no environment, no UI, no disc or medallion frame, no magic circle, no particle field, no text, no numbers, no logos. Clean finished character key art suitable as the source image for future animation.
